device_entry.description: 用于科学成像与实验数据界面的点状图形标注对象。这是一个非物理软件组件，源自 Nion Swift 图形模型，用于在图像或数据视图中表示单点标记，并支持位置管理、命中测试、拖拽编辑、微调以及基于 MIME 的序列化/复制交换，常用于交互式选点、特征标注和区域定义。
device_entry.description_en: A point-style graphical annotation object for scientific imaging and experimental data interfaces. This is a non-physical software component from the Nion Swift graphics model, used to represent a single point marker in an image or data view. It supports position management, hit testing, drag editing, nudging, and MIME-based serialization or copy/transfer, commonly for interactive point selection, feature marking, and region definition.
